whatIsTebnu.title: What is tebnu?

whatIsTebnu.bulletFind: Find help near you (services, one-time tasks, ongoing support).

tips.1: Pick the category that best matches what you need — you can post another request anytime.
tips.2: One-time is for a single visit; part-time and regular suit ongoing or repeating help.
tips.3: Pick your city from the suggestions (or GPS). Free text alone won’t unlock the next step.
tips.4: Choose a duration that fits the visit; helpers use it to decide if they can commit.
tips.5: Add a budget if you have one in mind — you can skip this and continue.
tips.6: When do you need help? Choose Now for urgent requests.
tips.7: Add any extra details that might help — or skip if you're all set.
tips.8: Photos or videos are optional but can clarify the job.
tips.9: Specific details get faster, better matches — add anything that clarifies the task.

special_video.title: Experience Tebnu
special_video.phrase: See How We Make Life Simpler
special_video.blurb: Post a request, get matched, and chat with local helpers nearby.
special_video.details: Watch how easy it is to connect with helpers in your neighborhood. Identity verification is optional and clearly marked.

childcare.title: Childcare
childcare.phrase: Trusted Care for Your Little Ones
childcare.blurb: Nannies and babysitters for everyday care or a last-minute sitter.
childcare.details: Meet nannies and babysitters who may fit your family. Check identity badges, qualifications and references yourself.

cleaning.title: Cleaning
cleaning.phrase: A pristine retreat, every single time.
cleaning.blurb: Housekeepers for a deep clean or regular upkeep at home.
cleaning.details: Our cleaning professionals are dedicated to making your home shine. From deep cleans to regular upkeep, we handle the dust so you can handle the rest.

cooking.title: Cooking
cooking.blurb: Home cooks and chefs for weeknight meals or dinner parties.
cooking.details: Find talented home cooks and chefs for daily meal prep or special dinner parties. Customizable to your tastes.

pickup.title: Delivery
pickup.blurb: Pickups and drop-offs for groceries, packages, and everyday errands.
pickup.details: From groceries to dry cleaning, our reliable couriers pick up and deliver essentials right to your door.

handyman.title: Handyman
handyman.blurb: Assembly, organizing, and small fixes around the house.
handyman.details: Need help organizing, assembling, or fixing? Our versatile helpers tackle any home task with precision.

match.title: Ideal helper, faster
match.description: AI matching shows you the best helpers first, ensuring a perfect fit.
match.explanation: Tell us what you need once. Tebnu ranks local helpers by skills, reviews, and availability so you spend minutes choosing — not hours searching through lists.
match.imageAlt: Local helpers ready to match with families

trust.title: Trust powered by AI
trust.description: Optional identity verification earns a clearly marked badge.
trust.explanation: Users may choose a Didit document and live-selfie check. The badge confirms that check only; it is not a background, qualification, reference or safety check.

reviews.title: Real reviews
reviews.description: Community ratings can help inform your own checks.
reviews.explanation: Reviews reflect user opinions and are not a guarantee. Read the details, ask questions and verify suitability yourself.
reviews.imageAlt: People who leave reviews after real help

language.title: No language barriers
language.description: Hebrew, English, French, Russian – built for smooth communication.
language.explanation: Post, chat, and read profiles in Hebrew, English, French, or Russian. The app is built for mixed-language homes in Israel, so details stay clear from the first message to the last.
language.imageAlt: Everyday help that works in any language

busy.title: Built for busy days
busy.description: AI handles the hard stuff, making finding help stress‑free.
busy.explanation: From posting a request to confirming a helper, the flow is short taps — not long forms. Get cleaning, childcare, cooking, or errands covered without pausing the rest of your day.
busy.imageAlt: Everyday help when you need it
